title: Plan a permissive-to-strict mTLS cutover
description: Model traffic to one enrolled destination. Mesh-capable sources use Istio mutual TLS; legacy sources still arrive as plaintext.

peerModes.label: PERMISSIVE
peerModes.detail: The receiving proxy accepts both mutual TLS and plaintext during migration.

peerModes.label: STRICT
peerModes.detail: The receiving proxy rejects plaintext and requires Istio mutual TLS.

dataPlaneModes.label: Sidecar
dataPlaneModes.detail: The destination pod has an Envoy sidecar that can enforce Layer 4 and Layer 7 policy.

dataPlaneModes.label: Ambient
dataPlaneModes.detail: Ztunnel provides the secure Layer 4 overlay; Layer 7 behavior requires a waypoint.
